settings.depth_null: every chunk of the pass is queued
settings.time_unit: the time unit of the predictions, the mean host time of a pass with every chunk queued in the chunk time run
settings.arrivals_source: generated in real time, not from any person
settings.sample: [delay_us, pass_us, newer_us, waits, launched, flags], see tools/gpu_depth_run_tables.py
settings.start_delay: from just before the request call to the first line of the calculation, any wait behind an earlier pass included
settings.pass_time: from the first line of the calculation to the return of its closing synchronize
settings.desktop_load: a working desktop. Utilization, memory and core clock are read before and after every run as utilization.gpu,memory.used,clocks.sm

note: One card, one machine, one model, generated arrivals. A stopped pass stops itself between launches, and the chunks it already queued run to their end. Nothing here is a latency bound, forced cancellation or a measure of human performance.
